carried_minor_issues: [minor] The size bound still does not hold against the 4096 budget. The count cap (32 scenes x 10 pending) lets one scene-status result reach about 12 KB with 1 pending proposal per scene (measured) and about 39 KB in the worst case (extrapolated by copying one scene entry, not run). test_result_size_is_bounded_and_recorded still asserts <4096 on a 2-scene fixture only. The worker disclosed this honestly as a D20 decision, and defect 2 only asked for a cap such as 32, so this is an open decision and not a failure of defect 2.

[minor] status() raises KeyError on any head version without approval.binding.ontology_revision. A single legacy record would then break the whole scene-status read for the conversation instead of degrading. The worker states this assumption: every current approval path writes the field (scene_project.py:349). Whether real legacy data exists is unverified.

[minor] public(), the UI projection, still ignores ontology drift. With ontology-only drift, Scene Studio shows no review needed while scene-status reports stale_context/requires_review. The worker disclosed this as a residual gap; it is outside the write set (app.py/UI).

[minor] The committed tests do not cover the exact-cap boundary (exactly 32 scenes → truncated False; exactly 10 pending → pending_truncated False) or ontology drift on a head-0 draft. I verified all of these by probe, but they are not in the regression suite.
